name: app-shater-thank-you-slide-bilingual-with-designer-contact-card
title: Shater case study closing: bilingual 'Thank You For Watching' with a designer contact card and 'BRD to' tagline
whatItIs: A light blue closing slide with a boxed Arabic 'شكراً علي المشاهدة' above 'Thank You For Watching', a designer contact card (photo, name, role, WhatsApp, email, 'Follow Me' button), an Arabic tagline 'من الـ BRD إلى تج...' and a dashboard-plus-phones cluster with a hard-hat icon.
whatItMeans: Professional and personal; a real contact card turns a portfolio ending into an invitation to connect.
techniques: Close bilingually for a wider audience.
Include a full contact card with a follow CTA.
Reuse hero screens small as a closing visual.

vocabulary.definition: A block with photo and ways to reach someone.
Content shown in two languages together.
